en.previews.title: Live preview
en.previews.lead: The change as it stands in the run's worktree, served to members of this project only.
en.previews.starting: Starting the dev server in the run's worktree.
en.previews.startRunless: A preview needs a live run holding a worktree. Start the issue's run first.
en.previews.frame.title: Preview of {issue}
en.previews.frame.slow: Still blank? Some browsers hold back the cookie a framed page needs. Open the preview in its own tab.
en.previews.frame.cookieRefused: This browser keeps no cookie for a page framed here, so the preview cannot sign you in inside Forge. Open it in its own tab.
en.previews.reproduce.title: Reproduce
en.previews.reproduce.lead: Open {fb} on the build its reporter used, with the project's demo data where it names some, else its dev environment, never production. For members of this project only. What you do there is recorded: clicks, console errors and failed requests, with every input masked.
en.previews.reproduce.starting: Checking the build out and starting its dev server.
en.previews.reproduce.closed: This reproduce is closed. Open another to try again.
en.previews.reproduce.redacted: The reporter's data was deleted, and its recordings with it, so there is nothing to reproduce.
en.previews.fix.title: Try the fix in {issue}
en.previews.fix.lead: {issue}'s run serves the fix for {fb} here. Use it, then say whether it fixes what was reported. When this same change ships, your answer closes {fb}; if what ships has changed since, you are asked again.
en.previews.fix.notLive: {issue} has no live preview of its fix yet. Its run opens one, and it shows here to confirm.
en.previews.fix.recorded.fixed: Recorded: fixed, on patch {patch}. When this change ships it closes {fb}.
en.previews.fix.recorded.not_fixed: Recorded: not fixed, on patch {patch}. When this change ships {fb} reopens with your note.
en.previews.recordings.title: Recordings
en.previews.recordings.reason.RECORDER_BLOC: the app's own security policy kept the recorder out
en.previews.recordings.reason.RECORDING_TOO: stopped at 50 MB, what came before is kept
en.previews.recordings.expired: Its events were deleted after 30 days. The timeline stays.
en.previews.turn.noRecording: {fb} has no recording yet. Reproduce it to make one.
en.previews.diagnosis.done: Routed {fb} to {issue}. Its run builds the fix, and the reporter confirms it on {fb}'s page.
en.previews.approveHint: Approving sends what this preview shows down its lane, and your pass counts as the verdict on the criteria it shows.
en.previews.closed.idle_closed: The preview closed after {minutes} minutes with nobody viewing. Reopening starts the dev server again at the same link.
en.previews.closed.approved: This preview was approved. Its link is closed.
en.previews.closed.abandoned: This preview was abandoned. Its link is closed.
en.previews.failed.lead: The preview could not start or stopped answering.
en.previews.failed.reason.DEV_SERVER_EXPOSE: The dev server listened beyond the box
en.previews.failed.reason.REF_NOT_FOUND: The box cannot fetch this build
en.previews.failed.fix.NO_START_COMMAND: Set the preview command in project settings, or add a dev script to package.json.
en.previews.failed.fix.PORT_UNDECLARED: Set preview.port, or give the command a {port} placeholder, in project settings.
en.previews.failed.fix.PORT_IN_USE: Free the port on the runner's box, or let the command take {port}.
en.previews.failed.fix.DEV_SERVER_EXITED: The tail of its output is below.
en.previews.failed.fix.DEV_SERVER_NOT_LISTE: Check the command listens on the port the setting names.
en.previews.failed.fix.DEV_SERVER_EXPOSED: The runner stopped it: it answered on an address other than loopback. Bind the dev server to 127.0.0.1.
en.previews.failed.fix.RUNNER_OFFLINE: Bring the runner back, then try again.
en.previews.failed.fix.RUNNER_CANNOT_PREVIE: Update the runner on that box.
en.previews.failed.fix.WORKTREE_GONE: Start a run on this issue, then try again.
en.previews.failed.fix.PRODUCTION_ENVIRONME: Name a dev or staging environment in project settings.
en.previews.failed.fix.REF_NOT_FOUND: Name a release or a commit the repository holds, then open it again.
en.previews.lane.title: Lane
en.previews.lane.fast: Fast lane: typecheck, touched tests, merge, then a web-only deploy.
en.previews.message.label: Ask for a change
en.previews.message.placeholder: Describe the change you want to see in this preview
en.previews.message.sent: Sent to the run. The preview reloads when it edits.
en.previews.message.readOnly: Asking for a change needs write access to this project.
en.previews.dock.title: Preview of {issue}
en.previews.settings.previewLead: How a run's dev server starts for a preview. Left empty, Forge reads the dev script of package.json and picks the port flag the framework takes.
en.previews.settings.commandEffect: Runs in the run's worktree. Put {port} where the dev server takes its port and the runner picks a free one; without it, name the port below.
en.previews.settings.portEffect: The one port the command listens on. Leave empty when the command holds {port}.
en.previews.settings.cwdEffect: A directory inside the repository the command runs in. Empty is the repository root.
en.previews.settings.idleEffect: A preview nobody views for this long stops its dev server. {min} to {max}, {default} when empty.
en.previews.settings.environmentEffect: The project environment whose variables the dev server gets. Never one whose tier is production.
en.previews.settings.fastLead: Which changes may ship from an approved preview without the full gates. Kernel, migrations, permissions and security files never do, whatever is listed here.
en.previews.settings.fastPathsEffect: Globs of the files a web-only deploy ships. Empty means nothing takes the fast lane.
en.previews.settings.fastTargetsEffect: Labels of the deploy binding's targets a web-only deploy fans out to, and nothing else. Required once paths are set.
en.previews.settings.fastAreaEffect: Added to the built-in globs for this area. Comma separated.
en.previews.idea.starting: Cutting a sketch branch on the box and starting its dev server.
en.previews.idea.closed: This idea preview is closed. Keep it from a live preview, or reopen a kept one from its requirement.
en.previews.idea.keep.label: Keep this idea
en.previews.idea.keep.altHint: One sentence a screen reader reads in the picture's place
en.previews.idea.kept.started: Started {key} from {from} and kept the preview as its picture.
en.previews.idea.kept.criteria: Criteria drafted from what you asked are waiting on the requirement, with a recommendation to accept them.
en.previews.idea.kept.stillFailed: The kept page could not be drawn here.
en.previews.idea.offer.title: Preview an idea for {key}
en.previews.idea.offer.what: Builds the idea on a throwaway branch and shows it live beside this chat. It runs with your own access.
